_comment: Input to tools/build_catalog.py, which publishes the remote catalog to
docs.freewili.com. This file carries ONLY what a UF2 cannot know about
itself: which apps to publish, and the storefront metadata around them.
name, tagline, description, version and updated are all read out of the
image's own fwog_uf2_info_t records unless overridden here, so rebuilding
an app and re-running the tool republishes what the new bytes actually
say. Override `name` where the record holds a C identifier and the
storefront wants prose; leave the rest alone so it cannot drift.
`source` is the <app>_main.uf2 the OG build produces. Relative paths
resolve against this repository's root, absolute paths are taken as given
-- the app repositories are separate checkouts and are not vendored here.
